case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

thank you for your offer and for twelve years of reliable supply. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. A two-year commitment gives you planning security; in return we ask for the package below.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We greatly appreciate our twelve-year partnership and welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract to ensure mutual planning security. 

We are prepared to accommodate your requested effective date of February 2027 and the two-year term, provided we agree on a sustainable price of €51.50. Therefore, our current offer stands at a price of €51.50 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our long-standing cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with our valued partners in the region. To help bridge the gap, we are prepared to make a further concession to €50.50. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our present Angebot stands at a price of €50.50 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. This proposal remains valid for 7 days.

Please understand that our high production costs limit our flexibility, and this price represents a significant step on our part. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. The craft we maintain at our foundry demands immense dedication, and we take great pride in delivering the quality you expect from us. We trust this offer demonstrates our deep commitment to our shared long relationship.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
